resource_risks.description: A future desktop shell could leave Python sidecar, local service, or CLI child processes running after cancellation or app exit.
resource_risks.mitigation: No sidecar or command execution runtime was implemented. The desktop and Windows/macOS profiles require lifecycle cleanup, timeout, update/rollback, and resource checks before adding those paths.

resource_risks.description: Running AI coding CLIs directly from renderer code could create command injection, path traversal, and resource leak risks.
resource_risks.mitigation: The Tauri default capability excludes local command execution. CLI tools remain optional adapters behind explicit future contracts.
